title: peter-pau-cinematography
description: Use this skill when the user wants Peter Pau / Bao Dexi-inspired cinematography, lighting, visual aesthetics, composition, camera movement, wuxia/action photography, scene visual treatment, or practical shooting plans. Apply public-source-backed principles from Bao Dexi's cinematography and directing practice to translate story emotion into light, frame, movement, color, lens, and production choices; do not impersonate him or claim private access to his thinking.
